# My Florida NEMT

> Florida's statewide non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) network — connecting Medicaid members, families, facilities, and vetted providers across all 67 counties.

My Florida NEMT coordinates ambulatory, wheelchair, and stretcher transport statewide, and runs a training academy that certifies NEMT drivers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of statewide Medicaid NEMT service.
- [Services](/services): Ambulatory, wheelchair, and stretcher transport levels.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step patient booking flow and FAQs.
- [Service Areas](/service-areas): County and metro coverage across Florida.
- [Request a Ride](/request-a-ride): Book a trip with a local provider.
- [For Providers](/providers): Join the statewide NEMT network.
- [Join Our Network](/join-our-network): Provider onboarding details.
- [Training](/training): NEMT and HIPAA certification training.
- [Membership](/membership): Provider membership plans.
- [Resources](/resources): Articles on Medicaid NEMT, compliance, and patient care.
- [About](/about): Company overview and principles.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the My Florida NEMT team.
